observations.detail: Unauthenticated preview displayed the sign-in page; three auth/bootstrap requests returned 401. Signed-in manager flow was separately exercised in isolated browser tests.

A log refresh surfaced daily-rollover database connection timeouts and a web-push alert scheduling failure in existing deployment logs. These were not caused by workbook import checks and were not investigated or changed.
The configured release:standard workflow appeared FAILED with no new output; the task did not run release checks, so the cause is unknown.
Two transient report-generation script errors were fixed; final inventory, hashes, and matrix reconciled.
